sprite.title: Game sprite generation
sprite.description: Upload a character, keep its original style, and generate eight-direction animations with live previews.
sprite.deleteProjectHint: Delete “{name}”, its source images, and all generated versions? This cannot be undone.
sprite.emptyHint: Start with a character image. Set up idle, walk, run, and attack animations, or add your own actions.
sprite.uploadHint: Click or drop PNG, JPEG, WebP · up to 8 MB
sprite.stylePreserved: Preserve the reference style, palette, clothing, and character details. Uploading does not call a model.
sprite.advancedAI: Advanced: redraw with an image model
sprite.aiRedrawHint: Only the buttons below call the image model. This may incur charges and alter image details. A configured image model is required; the uploaded original is kept.
sprite.mainPromptPlaceholder: Describe details to preserve, camera angle, and animation style…
sprite.noModel: Eight-direction generation and advanced AI redrawing need an available image model. Local background removal and inpainting remain available.
sprite.frameCountHint: Each action produces one sheet with 8 direction rows. More frames can reduce detail per frame.
sprite.actionsHint: Each enabled action generates all eight directions. Edit its prompt to regenerate that action independently.
sprite.actionPromptPlaceholder: Describe motion, timing, poses, and looping requirements…
sprite.idlePrompt: Stand naturally with subtle breathing, stable feet, and a seamless loop.
sprite.walkPrompt: Walk naturally with alternating steps, coordinated arm swings, and a seamless loop.
sprite.runPrompt: Run quickly with a slight forward lean, clear strides, and a seamless loop.
sprite.attackPrompt: Show a complete attack: anticipation, strike, impact, and recovery. Keep equipment consistent.
sprite.interrupted: Run interrupted. Completed results are kept; generate again to continue.
sprite.editWhileRunning: Keep editing while generation runs. Changes apply to the next save and generation.
sprite.generationHint: The model runs only when you click Generate. Each action keeps its version history. AI frame layouts may need prompt refinement and another attempt.
sprite.errorBusy: This project is generating. Stop it or wait for completion.
sprite.errorNotFound: This project no longer exists. Reload the project list.
sprite.errorInvalidData: Check the project name, actions, and generation settings, then retry.
sprite.errorGeneration: Image generation failed. Check the model connection and try again. Completed versions are kept.
sprite.errorProtocol: The server returned an invalid response. Please reload.
sprite.previewEmpty: Generate an action to preview its eight directions.
sprite.previewLoadFailed: Could not load image. Select a version or retry.
sprite.gridHint: One direction per row, clockwise from south. If the model misaligns frames, refine the prompt and regenerate.
sprite.invalidImage: Image cannot be decoded or format is unsupported.
sprite.imageTooLarge: Image must be within 8 MB, 4096 px per side and 16 megapixels.
sprite.processedNotice: Edits affect the current preview and export; the original is kept.
sprite.errorConcurrency: Two image jobs are already running. Please retry later.
sprite.errorResultLimit: This project has reached its version limit. Create a new project to continue.
sprite.errorStorage: Sprite project storage is unavailable. Check the runtime status.
sprite.bundleHint: Includes images, actions and downloaded local engines. No credentials.
sprite.bundleFailed: Could not import or export workflow package.
sprite.localToolsHint: Background removal and inpainting run locally without calling an image model. Download the open-source engines once, then process images offline.
sprite.engineRequestFailed: Local engine operation failed. Please retry.
sprite.engineDownloadFailed: The engine download did not finish.
sprite.engineNetworkFailed: The download source is unreachable or temporarily unavailable.
sprite.engineIntegrityFailed: The downloaded file failed verification and was not installed.
sprite.engineStorageFailed: The engine file could not be saved. Check the app data folder's permissions and file state.
sprite.engineRetryHint: Retry the download, or download the engine on an online computer, export a workflow ZIP, and import it here.
sprite.inpaintHint: Drag to select a watermark, or enter its percentage bounds. Only colors inside the selection change; alpha is preserved. Best for small marks on simple backgrounds; large occlusions cannot be reliably reconstructed.
sprite.localApplied: Local edit saved. The uploaded original is kept.
sprite.localFailed: Local processing failed. Check that the engine is fully downloaded, or try a smaller image.
inputs.invalidName: Variable names may contain letters, numbers and underscores, must not start with a number, and cannot use reserved names.
inputs.duplicateName: Variable “{name}” is duplicated. Use a unique name.
inputs.labelRequired: Every input needs a display label.
inputs.invalidDefault: The default value for “{name}” does not match its type.
inputs.definitionHint: Provide images, prompts, and other content each time you run. Choose here what the workflow asks for.
inputs.label: Display label
inputs.taskHint: Describe what this run should accomplish.
inputs.materialsHint: Provide file paths, links, code snippets, or content to process.
inputs.constraintsHint: Specify scope, format, prohibited actions, and acceptance criteria.
inputs.contextHint: Add task details and context for this run. This does not change the workflow template.
inputs.startFailed: The workflow could not start. Check the inputs or page error and retry.
inputs.runHint: Inputs apply only to this run. Use a different task next time while reusing the same processing steps and template.
inputs.nodeRulesHint: Describe how this node processes data. Provide the actual task at run time; click a variable to insert it at the cursor.
inputs.invalidDefinition: Input definitions are incomplete or invalid. Check variable names, labels, types, and defaults.
inputs.valueTooLong: “{name}” is too long. Use at most 16,000 characters.
inputs.unknownInput: Input “{name}” is not declared by this workflow.
inputs.invalidValue: The value for “{name}” does not match its type.
inputs.previewFailed: The preview could not load. The uploaded media can still be used for this run.
inputs.oneFile: Choose one media file per input.
inputs.mediaType: Choose an image or video format supported by this input.
inputs.imageLimit: Images must be no larger than 8 MB.
inputs.videoLimit: Videos must be no larger than 64 MB.
imageNodes.templateDescription: Generate actions by direction, remove backgrounds, align frames and export an atlas. Every node is editable.
imageNodes.referenceHint: Upload a character image; generation preserves its original style.
imageNodes.requestEstimate: Estimated image model calls: {count}. Each call generates one direction of an action. Adjust directions, action nodes and frame counts on the canvas.
imageNodes.inputHint: Upload the image in the run form. Add or edit input fields in workflow settings.
imageNodes.modelsFailed: Could not load image models. Try again later.
imageNodes.generateHint: This node makes approximately {count} image calls, one direction per call, preserving the reference style, proportions and palette.
imageNodes.modelHint: Download the algorithm on demand. Once installed it works offline without a generative image API.
imageNodes.engineMissing: Local algorithm missing. Download its dependencies first.
imageNodes.engineFailed: Algorithm download failed. Check the connection and retry.
imageNodes.colorsHint: Leave empty to detect colors at the image edges, or choose up to 8 colors.
imageNodes.edgeConnected: Only remove background connected to edges
imageNodes.gridHint: Generated grid metadata takes precedence. Other images use the grid below.
imageNodes.orderHint: Listed frames come first in the chosen order; remaining frames follow. Turn off “Keep this frame” to remove one.
imageNodes.previewHint: After running, inspect the animation, direction and onion skins below. Multiple action branches can connect here.
imageNodes.exportHint: Bake all input frames into a transparent PNG atlas with action, direction and timing metadata.
imageNodes.noResult: Run the workflow to see this node’s results.
imageNodes.sourceRequired: Connect a valid image input node first.
imageNodes.decodeFailed: Could not decode the image. Check its format and size.
imageNodes.generationFailed: Some images could not be generated. Completed results are kept below. Adjust the prompt and retry.
imageNodes.tooLarge: Image dimensions or frame count exceed the limit. Reduce the input size or number of frames.
imageNodes.timeout: Processing timed out. Reduce the number of frames and retry.
imageNodes.invalidOutput: Invalid image settings or output. Check the node configuration.
imageNodes.regionHint: Inpaint only the chosen rectangle, for watermarks or small blemishes. Check its position in the preview first.
imageNodes.runNodeHint: Reuse completed upstream outputs without rerunning other nodes. Complete an upstream run first.
imageNodes.sourceStale: Upstream settings changed or completed outputs are missing. Run the upstream nodes or the full workflow first.
imageNodes.maxFrameSizeHint: Keep each frame’s longest edge within {size} pixels (default: 256). Larger frames are scaled down proportionally; smaller frames are not enlarged.
inputs.emptyDefinition: No run inputs yet. Add images, text, or video to reuse this workflow with new content.
editor.settingsDescription: Set the workflow name, run inputs, and defaults. Provide the actual content each time you run.
editor.inspectorDescription: Edit the selected node and inspect its output and run history.
editor.manualTriggerHint: Choose Test run to start the workflow and provide images, prompts, and other inputs for this run.
editor.parallelHint: Wait for every upstream branch to finish before running the next nodes.
workbench.invalid: Check the name, reference, actions, directions and frame count. Up to 8 actions and 512 frames are supported.
workbench.customized: This workflow was customized on the canvas. Continue editing there to preserve its graph.
workbench.description: A reusable workflow created in the Game Asset Workbench.
